title: Decision timeline per topic
observation: Results group by latest decision and date; no chronological topic timeline found in reviewed controls.
reason: A timeline lets a lead distinguish replacement, reversal, cancellation and scope changes before acting.

title: Per-decision history and sources
observation: Current evidence/source/date/line are visible. No complete per-decision provenance history view found.
reason: A reviewer needs all source decisions, not only the latest summary, to resolve conflicting instructions.

title: Export findings as CSV, Markdown or PDF
observation: No findings export action found in Results or audited desktop API routes. Diagnostics copy is available.
reason: Teams need reviewable findings in issue trackers, release checklists and meeting records.

title: Owner assignment and follow-up reminders
observation: Owners imported from task data can appear; no assignment/editor or owner follow-up workflow found in result actions.
reason: A finding needs a responsible person and a due date to turn detection into completed propagation.

title: Mark fixed and automatically verify
observation: Dismiss/false-positive/snooze exist; file watcher rechecks edits. No explicit fixed-and-verify workflow found.
reason: Hiding a finding should be distinguishable from checking that its source line was corrected.

title: Bulk dismiss
observation: Per-finding actions exist; no selection and bulk dismiss control found.
reason: A large first run otherwise requires repetitive individual clicks and makes triage costly.

title: Finding filters and grouping
observation: Topic grouping and search are visible; filter control audit saved. Owner/folder/severity grouping views were not found.
reason: Leads need a view of their own folder, release, owner and urgency rather than one long mixed list.

title: First-run onboarding
observation: Empty home gives folder-add guidance; model consent and data coverage require separate Settings steps.
reason: A guided first check should explain folder boundary, external-send consent, estimate and what was skipped.

title: Undo dismiss
observation: Per-item hide actions work; no visible undo in results after dismissal found. An API can reopen a finding.
reason: A mistaken dismissal must be reversible from the UI without editing app state.

title: Keyboard and accessibility
observation: Skip link and several ARIA names exist. Mail Escape failed after Enter; accessible-name/focus audit saved.
reason: Reliable focus and accessible labels are required to triage quickly and to use a screen reader.

title: English UI option
observation: No language selector found in reviewed settings. Current UI strings remain Korean.
reason: Mixed-language teams need translated controls while preserving original evidence text.

title: Weekly digest
observation: Daily digest setting exists. No weekly summary schedule found.
reason: A weekly review should collect new, resolved, dismissed and overdue findings instead of repeating a live list.

title: Calendar write-back preference
observation: Connections explicitly advertise read-only calendar access. User preference question sent; no answer yet.
reason: An optional reviewed change proposal could close the loop, but should be built only if the user wants it.

title: Exact-line file links
observation: Details show file and line. Existing open-location action accepts a target path without a line argument.
reason: Opening an editor at the stale line would shorten repair time and reduce wrong-file edits.

title: Renamed and moved files
observation: Identity-preservation test pending; filenames participate in source evidence and file indexing.
reason: A rename should update evidence paths without duplicating or resurrecting dismissed findings.

title: Time zones for mail and calendar
observation: Mail shows local dates and times; ICS sample includes Asia/Seoul. Cross-zone boundary test pending.
reason: A UTC event near midnight must be compared with the decision on the correct local calendar day.

title: Multiple Google accounts
observation: One Gmail connection and one account status are exposed. No account picker/add-second-account flow found.
reason: A lead may keep school, personal and organization projects in different accounts.

title: Offline behavior
observation: Cached local UI remains usable during ordinary reads; failed model checks expose a retrying state. Scoped outage test pending.
reason: Offline mode should preserve evidence, explain unavailable actions and avoid repeated expensive retries.

title: Model provider outage
observation: Default model extraction errors prevented both demo scans. Partial results/recovery messaging needs clearer coverage.
reason: The core workflow needs bounded retries and a trustworthy last-verified result while the provider is failing.

title: Data export and delete all
observation: Diagnostics copy and delete-all exist; no portable user-data export found. Delete-all also removes shared credential-store entries.
reason: Users need backup/migration and scoped project deletion without unexpectedly disconnecting every account.

title: Live cost and failed-run accounting
observation: Extraction progress showed zero requests while real HTTP calls occurred; failed scans had no completion request total.
reason: The run budget must include extraction, failures and retries before the confirmation gate, not only a successful last cycle.

title: Clarification actually updates verdicts
observation: F06 answer cleared the question but returned zero new requests and retained all five UNCERTAIN verdicts.
reason: Human clarification only saves effort when the answer changes the scope decision and produces actionable results.

title: Cache removal and recoverable invalid responses
observation: Malformed JSON in stored extraction responses repeatedly failed demo scans; removing a watched folder deletes its stored state.
reason: A user needs a focused retry of a bad response and optional reuse when re-adding an unchanged project.
